from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    n=len(grid)
    rows=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        vals=[x for x in row if x]
        if len(vals)>=5 and len(set(vals))==1:
            rows.append((i,vals[0]))
    for ri,(r,c) in enumerate(rows):
        # Complete each horizontal bar across its occupied span.
        cols=[j for j,x in enumerate(grid[r]) if x]
        lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
        for j in range(lo,hi+1): out[r][j]=c
        # Gaps in bars continue vertically toward the previous bar / top.
        gaps=[j for j in range(lo,hi+1) if grid[r][j]==0]
        upper=rows[ri-1][0]+1 if ri else 0
        for j in gaps:
            for i in range(upper,r): out[i][j]=c
    return out
'''
